approve_device.description: Approve a device that is waiting to join your tailnet, or revoke a device's approval so it loses access. Only matters when device approval is turned on.

description: Manage your Tailscale network: approve, rename, tag and remove devices, turn on subnet routes, manage users, invites and auth keys, and set DNS. Start a workflow when a device joins, waits for approval, goes offline or its key is about to expire.

tailscale_device_approved_trigger.description: Runs when a device is approved to join your tailnet, including a new device added with a pre-approved auth key.

output.authorized: Whether it is approved to join
output.device: Everything Tailscale says about the device
output.device_id: The device's ID (nodeId), for the device actions
output.name: Its MagicDNS name, such as pangolin.tailfe8c.ts.net
output.user: Who added it (its owner, unless it is tagged)

parameters.description: Only devices with this tag, such as tag:server. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tag

tailscale_device_needs_approval_trigger.description: Runs when a device is waiting for an admin to approve it, so you can check it and approve it with 'Approve or revoke device'. Needs device approval turned on in Tailscale.

output.authorized: Whether it is approved to join
output.device: Everything Tailscale says about the device
output.device_id: The device's ID (nodeId), for the device actions
output.name: Its MagicDNS name, such as pangolin.tailfe8c.ts.net
output.user: Who added it (its owner, unless it is tagged)

parameters.description: Only devices with this tag, such as tag:server. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tag

tailscale_device_offline_trigger.description: Runs when a device has been offline for a while, such as a server that dropped off the network. Devices already offline when the workflow is turned on don't start it until they come back and drop off again.

output.authorized: Whether it is approved to join
output.device: Everything Tailscale says about the device
output.device_id: The device's ID (nodeId), for the device actions
output.name: Its MagicDNS name, such as pangolin.tailfe8c.ts.net
output.offline_minutes: How many minutes it has been offline
output.user: Who added it (its owner, unless it is tagged)

parameters.description: How long a device must be offline first. Defaults to 15 minutes.
parameters.name: offline_minutes

parameters.description: Only devices with this tag, such as tag:server. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tag

tailscale_key_expiring_trigger.description: Runs when a device's key will expire soon, so someone can sign in on it again or turn its key expiry off before it disconnects.

output.authorized: Whether it is approved to join
output.days_left: How many days until the key expires
output.device: Everything Tailscale says about the device
output.device_id: The device's ID (nodeId), for the device actions
output.name: Its MagicDNS name, such as pangolin.tailfe8c.ts.net
output.user: Who added it (its owner, unless it is tagged)

parameters.description: How far ahead to warn. Defaults to 7 days.
parameters.name: days

parameters.description: Only devices with this tag, such as tag:server. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tag

tailscale_new_device_trigger.description: Runs when a device joins your tailnet, such as a new laptop, phone or server. Devices already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.authorized: Whether it is approved to join
output.device: Everything Tailscale says about the device
output.device_id: The device's ID (nodeId), for the device actions
output.name: Its MagicDNS name, such as pangolin.tailfe8c.ts.net
output.user: Who added it (its owner, unless it is tagged)

parameters.description: Only devices with this tag, such as tag:server. Leave blank for all.
parameters.name: tag

tailscale_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when someone joins your tailnet. People already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.login_name: Their login, usually an email address
output.role: Their role, such as member or admin
output.user: Everything Tailscale says about the user
output.user_id: The user's ID, for the user actions

tailscale_policy_changed_trigger.description: Runs when your tailnet policy file (its access rules) is changed, with the file as it is now, so changes can be reviewed or recorded.

output.etag: Identifies this version of the file
output.policy: The policy file as it is now

tailscale_user_needs_approval_trigger.description: Runs when someone is waiting for an admin to approve them before they can join. Needs user approval turned on in Tailscale.

output.login_name: Their login, usually an email address
output.role: Their role, such as member or admin
output.user: Everything Tailscale says about the user
output.user_id: The user's ID, for the user actions
